title: LinkedIn Hiring Tracker Input
description: Track LinkedIn jobs with parsed salary, tech stack, and seniority. Enter keywords, pick a location, filter by experience and date, and run.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: One or more job search queries. Each query runs as a separate search. Examples: 'software engineer', 'product manager', 'data scientist'.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Locations to filter. Each location combines with each keyword. Use the spelling LinkedIn accepts, e.g. 'United States', 'London, United Kingdom', 'Remote'. Leave empty for worldwide.

experienceLevel.title: Experience level
experienceLevel.description: Filter by seniority as LinkedIn defines it. Leave blank for any.

jobType.title: Job type
jobType.description: Employment type. Leave blank for any.

remoteFilter.title: Remote filter
remoteFilter.description: Restrict to on-site, remote, or hybrid roles.

postedSince.title: Posted since
postedSince.description: Only include jobs posted within this window.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Hard cap on jobs returned across all queries. LinkedIn exposes about 1000 results per search.

parseSalary.title: Parse salary from description
parseSalary.description: Extract salary range, currency, and period (annual, hourly, monthly) from the job description text. LinkedIn does not expose a structured salary field for most jobs. Built in. No extra cost.

extractTechStack.title: Extract tech stack
extractTechStack.description: Scan the description for 120 common languages, frameworks, cloud services, and tools. Returns a deduped lowercase array. Built in. No extra cost.

classifySeniority.title: Classify seniority tier from title
classifySeniority.description: Map the job title to an intern, entry, mid, senior, staff, lead, manager, director, vp, or c-suite bucket. Useful for comp benchmarking across noisy LinkedIn labels. Built in. No extra cost.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip job IDs already pushed in previous runs. Turn off to refresh stale rows.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Datacenter works for LinkedIn guest endpoints at low volume. Use residential for runs above a few hundred jobs.
